Computer skills: Website administrators are proficient with computers, computer software and computer troubleshooting.
Management skills: Administrators manage entire websites and databases and a team of professionals, requiring strong management skills like communication, coaching and mentoring.
Organisational skills: Administrators typically have strong organisational skills to organise their time, different projects, extensive web data and their team.

A VGA (Video Graphics Array) port, also called a DB-15 port, is a 15-pin female port that transmits analog video.
An S-Video port is a 4-pin or 7-pin round video port sometimes used to connect to a television.
A DVI (Digital Video Interface) port transmits digital or analog video.
An HDMI (High-Definition Multimedia Interface) port transmits digital video and audio (not analog transmissions) and is often used to connect to home theater equipment.
A DisplayPort transmits digital video and audio (not analog transmissions) and is slowly replacing VGA and DVI ports on personal computers.
A Thunderbolt port transmits both video and data on the same port and cable.
A network port, also called an Ethernet port, or an RJ-45 port, is used by a network cable to connect to the wired network.
Gigabit Ethernet runs at 1,000 Mbps or 1 Gbps (gigabit per second).
A megabit is one million bits and a gigabit is one billion bits.
A megabit is one million bits and a gigabit is one billion bits.
A bit is a binary value of one or zero.
A parallel port is a 25-pin female port used by older printers.
A modem port, also called an RJ-11 port, is used to connect dial-up phone lines to computers.
